data.title: fal Acquires Lucent, Welcomes Co-Founders Dimi Panagiotopoulos and Alex Koumpas to the team
data.description: In a recent development, Fal has successfully purchased Lucent, an innovative AI agent-based platform specializing in creative media. This acquisition includes bringing on board the two founders of Lucent, in line with Fal's strategy to support and invest in emerging talents driving advancements in generative media. The transaction was confirmed on September 14, 2026, in San Francisco. It signifies Fal's commitment to fostering creativity and innovation in the industry, aligning with its vision for the future.

data.title: Payment Nerds Secures $2 Million Credit Facility from Espresso Capital to Accelerate Growth
data.description: In Nashville, Tennessee on September 14, 2026, Payment Nerds, a company specializing in merchant services and payment processing, disclosed receiving a $2 million credit facility from Espresso Capital. The financial boost will bolster the company's growth efforts and facilitate its expansion endeavors.

data.title: InventHelp Inventor Develops Disposable Plate Dispenser (CLR-373)
data.description: A new invention called DISH-SPENSE has been created by an inventor from Park Forest, Ill. The product aims to dispense one disposable plate at a time during events like picnics and parties. The idea behind this design is to eliminate the need for guests to touch multiple plates. This invention is seen as a convenient solution for events, ensuring hygiene and ease of use. The inventor's innovation is set to transform the way plates are handled, making event planning more streamlined.

data.title: Jamf Announces Same-Day Support For macOS Golden Gate 27, iOS 27 And Other OS 27 Releases
data.description: Minneapolis-based Jamf, a leading provider of Apple device management and security solutions for businesses, has announced immediate support for Apple's latest software updates. This includes macOS Golden Gate 27, iOS 27, iPadOS 27, tvOS 27, visionOS 27, and watchOS 27, all of which were officially released today. Jamf's swift response ensures that businesses can seamlessly transition to the new Apple operating systems without disruptions. By conducting thorough testing during Apple's beta phase, Jamf guarantees full compatibility with all the latest releases for a smooth user experience.
